label: D2 after a1 reaches S1, growing over the episode, strongest after a1-S2-unrewarded
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) * belief ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) * ((tv("action", -1) == 1) + (tv("action", -2) == 1) + (tv("action", -3) == 1)) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) * (prev_common == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) * belief_cover ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == S1) * (tv("reward", -1) == 0)
explanation: Silent at D1 and GO. Fires only at D2 when the agent has just chosen a1 and the common transition to S1 is shown (a1->S1 conjunction). Its strength grows with episode time, steeper than the D2 timing baseline. It gets a large extra boost (+0.38) when the previous trial was a1->S2 unrewarded, i.e. the agent stayed with a1 after a rare loss and then reached S1. Every other D2 (a2, or a1->S2 rare) sits slightly below baseline. The ideal-observer belief that S1 is good is positively related (residual rises across belief deciles), but once episode time is in the fit it adds almost nothing, so it is left out of the short form. The free fit adds belief, recent a1 history, the previous trial being rare or unrewarded, and belief cover, for only a small gain (test 0.35 vs 0.31). The unexplained part is mostly near-saturated firing (about 1.3-1.5) in long a1 streaks late in the episode. The model policy decile tracks that better (0.27 alone) than observed cues do (observed ceiling 0.32, all-cue ceiling 0.43). No future variables: in_action at D2 is the choice just made.
